Rae CSM: quick post-cutover check for Synapse private/VPC onboarding. Found three small follow-ups: asymmetric routing, KMS region mismatch, and a control-plane log filter.
Ibrahim Eng: what did infra show?
Rae CSM: 1) traffic to us-east-2 svc endpoints sometimes routes via a different TGW route table causing 504s on long-running uploads. 2) KMS CMK was created in us-west-2 but logs/CloudTrail land in us-east-2 -> cross-region policy gap. 3) CloudWatch subscription filter missed some control-plane events (field name mismatch).
Sam (Synapse): we saw `504 gateway timeout` during a 2.5MB artifact push. We can accept a routing change if recommended.
Ibrahim Eng: likely route table priority on the transit gateway. We can add an explicit route for Synapse VPC -> us-east-2 endpoints to prefer the primary attachment. Will push change and test.
Keiko Sec: for KMS, it's safer to recreate the CMK in us-east-2 and alias it `alias/redwood/synapse`. Temp workaround: add key policy allowing `arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-priv-role` across both regions, but rotation & compliance want same-region keys for audit.
Marta CE: audit logs: I updated the filter with `eventSource` alternatives; CLI used: `aws logs put-subscription-filter --log-group-name /redwood/synapse/controlplane --filter-name cp-shim --filter-pattern '{($.eventSource = "redwood.amazonaws.com") || ($.eventSource = "api.redwood")}' --destination-arn arn:aws:logs:us-east-2:123456789012:destination:splunk-synapse'`
Rae CSM: action items: Synapse ops (Sam) -> confirm TGW route change and run artifact push test. Synapse sec -> recreate CMK in us-east-2 or apply cross-region grant. Marta -> monitor control-plane delivery for 24h. Ibrahim -> add runbook note on TGW route priority.
Sam (Synapse): we'll make the route change in 30m and report back.
infra-bot: Deployment 6391110000 completed for synapse-priv (green) :white_check_mark:
Rae CSM: noting medium renewal watch: onboarding delayed ~1 day because of routing + KMS work. Not critical but flagging renewals. Also feedback: docs could use an explicit example mapping for `redwood.request_id -> splunk.request_id` and a short grok for timestamp parsing. Ibrahim, can you add a snippet to the runbook?
Ibrahim Eng: yup, will add a mapping + grok line by EOD.
Sam (Synapse): thanks, will ping when tests finish.
